newsitem.title: UK: Strong pound weighs on Burmah, others.
newsitem.headline: Strong pound weighs on Burmah, others.

text.p: Shares in Burmah Castrol Plc eased two pence to 990-1/2, held back by sterling's strength, while the overall stock market powered ahead, dealers said.
Burmah has large businesses abroad, mainly in India and the Far East. Another company with major foreign operations, BTR Plc, was down three pence to 195-1/2.
The strong pound means that profits posted abroad are hit when they are "translated" into sterling.
But unlike exporters such as British Steel Plc, BTR's and Burmah's underlying performance is unaffected by the currency exchange rate.
British Steel Plc, meanwhile, was down 1/4 pence to 151-1/4. British Airways Plc, which earlier said its average fare yields were hit by the pound's strength, eased 2-1/2 pence to 685.
